# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update with current upstream bug fixes. Linux font fallback can now select a different face when fontconfig offers a closer match. Use an explicit family, style, or bundled typeface where text metrics and glyph selection must remain deterministic.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback may select a different face** — Skia now tries fontconfig's direct match before the previous sorted fallback path, which can change fallback glyphs or text metrics. Specify the family and style explicitly, or bundle the typeface, when deterministic font selection matters.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m153** — Moves the bundled renderer to Skia m153 and includes the current upstream Chrome m153 bug-fix sync. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (September 3, 2026)

Preview 1 opens the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and its current upstream bug fixes.
